caption: Agentic CLI
name: agentic_cli
description: Agent Journal's Agentic CLI extension. Uses ACP's session, prompt turn, content block, tool call and permission vocabulary within OCSF. The uid 901 is provisional and unregistered: it is not reserved in the OCSF extensions registry. Packages written against it pin this uid, this version and the compiled schema hash in run.json; readers resolve class names through that pin and refuse a mismatched assignment.
